title: EdgeLoom device profile
description: A hub-side device profile: the set of capabilities a driver exposes for one device, and the categories that describe it. This is the contract both EdgeLoom paths converge on -- profiles emitted by the translator and profiles rewritten by the patcher must both validate against it.

name.description: Profile identifier. Conventionally matches the profile's filename stem.

components.description: Addressable sub-units of the device. A device with no sub-units still declares a single component, by convention 'main'.

id.description: Component identifier, unique within the profile.

categories.description: Device categories used for presentation and grouping.

id.description: Capability identifier. Vendor capabilities are namespaced, e.g. 'adminmusic34435.autoRelockTime'; standard ones are bare, e.g. 'switch'.

version.description: Capability version. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

config.description: Platform presentation configuration for this capability, e.g. value ranges. Its inner shape is owned by the platform, not by EdgeLoom, so it is accepted as an opaque object.

deviceConfig.description: Platform device-level configuration for this capability. Like config, its inner shape is owned by the platform and is accepted opaquely.
